cohort: The study included 113 pediatric patients aged 11 months to 17 years, previously diagnosed with Congenital Heart Disease (CHD) by echocardiography at Muhimbili National Hospital.
finding: VSD was identified as the most common congenital cardiac defect, and Cardiac CT was found to be statistically significantly superior to echocardiography in evaluating complex TOF characteristics, making it an ideal modality for detailed anatomic review.
mod_finding: Cesarean-section delivery was strongly associated with having a Patent Ductus Arteriosus (PDA) anomaly (p=0.001).
